faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Hyderabad Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Assistant position at IIT Hyderabad is 22nd August 2026. Ensure you complete and submit your application before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B. Tech/B. E. degree with a First Class in Mechanical, Aerospace, or Automobile Engineering to be eligible for the Project Assistant role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 18,000.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant role at IIT Hyderabad?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial application evaluation, followed by shortlisting of candidates, and finally an online interview.

faq.question: Q6. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for a contractual position as a Project Assistant at IIT Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q7. Where is IIT Hyderabad located?
faq.answer: IIT Hyderabad is located in Sangareddy, Telangana, with the pincode 502284.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Assistant position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from any state apply for this job?
faq.answer: The notification is for IIT Hyderabad, located in Telangana. While candidates from any state can apply if they meet the eligibility criteria, the job is based in Sangareddy, Telangana.

faq.question: Q10. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official website or the provided application link.
